INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

4. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

5. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

6. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

7. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.

9. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

10. When practising Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.

11. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Creative writing- Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 8.1.1Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 8.2.1 Extensive Reading: Advertisements and News and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 8.3.1 Functional Writing: Filling Forms and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
